title: Inconsistent trigger ID naming in .warren/triggers.yaml
description: The documentationwatch trigger ID "documentationwatch-weekly-yevbg7729qm3" has a random alphanumeric suffix while all other triggers use clean descriptive IDs (nightwatch-patrol, bugwatch-patrol, gatewatch-patrol, ratchetwatch-patrol, tastewatch-sample). This breaks the naming convention and could cause confusion during maintenance.

title: Hardcoded API key in .pi/extensions/lemonade-server.ts
description: The Pi extension file .pi/extensions/lemonade-server.ts contains a hardcoded API key (apiKey: "lemonade"). While the key is trivial and the server is on a private IP (100.108.123.126), this is a hardcoded credential pattern that should be externalized to an environment variable or secrets manager to prevent accidental exposure.

title: Empty seed data files tracked in git (.seeds/issues.jsonl, plans.jsonl, templates.jsonl)
description: Three seed data files are empty but tracked in git: .seeds/issues.jsonl, .seeds/plans.jsonl, .seeds/templates.jsonl. These empty files add noise to the repository and serve no purpose. They should either be populated or removed from tracking.

title: Documentation drift: .mulch/README.md shows config examples not present in mulch.config.yaml
description: The .mulch/README.md documents configuration examples for prime.default_mode and search.boost_factor that are commented out (not set) in the actual .mulch/mulch.config.yaml. The README says "Omit to let ml prime auto-flip" which describes the default behavior, but the examples in the README could mislead readers into thinking these are the actual configured values.
